maddeler.e:
نصطبغ (form VIII)
# نَصْطَبِغُ (naṣṭabiḡu) /nasˤ.tˤa.bi.ɣu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِصْطَبَغَ (iṣṭabaḡa)
# نَصْطَبِغَ (naṣṭabiḡa) /nasˤ.tˤa.bi.ɣa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِصْطَبَغَ (iṣṭabaḡa)
# نَصْطَبِغْ (naṣṭabiḡ) /nasˤ.tˤa.biɣ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِصْطَبَغَ (iṣṭabaḡa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
